title: Allocate Capital Across Partial Investments
real_world_story: An investment platform allows an investor to divide capital across different opportunities. Some investments can be partially funded, allowing the investor to invest only a fraction of the required capital.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Investment capital requirements and expected values
real_world_connection.target_represents: Maximum portfolio value achievable using the available capital
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Prioritizing investments according to their expected value per unit of capital

problem_statement: Given N investment opportunities, each with a capital requirement and expected value, and a fixed amount of available capital, determine the maximum portfolio value when investments can be selected partially.
task: Allocate the available capital to maximize the total expected value. An investment may be selected completely or partially.
input_format: The first line contains two integers N and C, representing the number of investments and the available capital. The next N lines contain two integers capital and value for each investment.
output_format: Print the maximum portfolio value rounded to two decimal places.

examples.explanation: The first two investments use 30 units of capital and provide 160 value. The remaining 20 units are invested in half of the third investment, providing another 80 value.
Both investments can be selected completely because their combined capital requirement is exactly 30.

expected_algorithm.name: Fractional Knapsack
expected_algorithm.reason: Investments can be partially selected, so choosing opportunities with the highest value-to-capital ratio first maximizes the portfolio value.

hint: Calculate the value-to-capital ratio for every investment.
Select the highest-ratio investments completely whenever possible.
Take a fraction of the next investment when the remaining capital is insufficient.
real_world_takeaway: Fractional Knapsack models portfolio allocation when investment opportunities can receive partial funding.
